allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Add Amax configuration, primary-400 color, and optimize servo scanning

Major Features:
- Amax configuration now properly writes to DEFAULT area (address 85)
- Primary-400 color added for lighter button hover states
- Optimized servo scanning from 32 to 16 IDs with early exit
- Auto-Discovery feature for automatic baud rate detection
- Proper port disconnect functionality

Amax Implementation:
- Added AMAX = 85 to MemoryAddress enum in protocol.ts
- Created writeAmax() method in websocket-serial.ts for DEFAULT area writes
- Updated confirmServoConfig() to validate and write Amax value (0-254 range)
- InputRow component created for configuration form fields

Design System Updates:
- Added --color-primary-400: rgb(27, 255, 179) to design-tokens.css
- Updated button hover states to use lighter primary-400 instead of darker primary-700
- Buttons now "glow" brighter on hover for better visual feedback

Servo Scanning Optimizations:
- Reduced default scan range from 32 to 16 IDs (cuts worst-case time from 16s to 8s)
- Added stopOnFirst parameter (default true) to exit scan after finding first servo
- Typical scan time now ~3.5 seconds instead of 16 seconds

Multi-Baud Auto-Discovery:
- Implemented scanServosMultiBaud() that tries [1000000, 115200, 57600, 9600]
- Added "Auto-Discovery" as default option in baud rate dropdown
- System automatically detects correct baud and updates dropdown
- After successful discovery, dropdown shows detected baud for next pairing

Port Management:
- Added disconnect message handler to bridge-server.js
- Created disconnectPort() method that releases serial port but keeps WebSocket alive
- Disconnect badge properly releases COM port for use by other programs
- Fixed "port already in use" errors

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed Amax not being written to servo (was only writing ID before)
- Fixed Svelte 5 dropdown reactivity using class with $state field
- Fixed baud rate selection and Auto-Discovery workflow

Components:
- InputRow.svelte: Reusable input component with icon, label, optional remove button
- SettingRow.svelte: Fixed dropdown manager reactivity with proper $derived usage
- Updated confirmServoConfig() with complete validation and EEPROM/DEFAULT writes

Technical Details:
- DEFAULT area (address 85+) uses standard WRITE_DATA instruction (0x03)
- No need for REG_WRITE + ACTION pattern for Amax writes
- All servo memory areas (EPROM, RAM, DEFAULT) use same write protocol

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
